historical_basis: Božalość, also transliterated Božaloshtsh or Bozaloshtsh, is a messenger of misfortune or death in Wendish mythology (the Wends, Lusatian Sorbs). An 1886 article, Das Spreewaldhaus by W. v. Schulenburg, links it with the elder bush and describes it as a woman in white with long, unkempt hair and red eyes. Biren Bonnerjea describes it as a little long-haired woman who weeps under the window of someone about to die.
